Tests that SVGSVGElement.getElementById() and SVGGraphicsElement.getBBox() are side-effect-free.
Expression `svgEl.getElementById('svg-path')`
has side effect: false, expected: false
Expression `svgPath.getBBox()`
has side effect: false, expected: false
Expression `svgEl.pauseAnimations()`
has side effect: true, expected: true
Expression `svgPath.getCTM()`
has side effect: true, expected: true
Expression `svgEl.getElementById({ toString() { window.pwned = 1; return 'svg-path'; } })`
has side effect: true, expected: true
